messages:
olivia: quick sync — we need a concise checklist + owners for the Datadog + OpenTelemetry tracing integration before we spin up the marketplace listing. who owns what? :spiral_calendar:
marcel: I can take runtime artifacts (propagation + header compatibility). need to confirm span naming conventions with product.
jess: I'll own marketplace tile copy + assets. also need legal signoff for logos — can we aim for a week turnaround? :calendar:
sahil: happy to own the customer demo + quickstart repo. i'll add a small sample app that shows trace + logs correlation. link to example app I'll push to integrations/trace-quickstart.
olivia: perfect. items to cover (short):
- runtime compatibility (OTel collector config + Redwood runtime headers)
- span naming & semantic conventions (search, model-serving, cache)
- prebuilt dashboards (Datadog dashboard JSON + queries)
- quickstart repo + sample traces/logs correlation
- marketplace metadata + logos/benefits + legal review
- joint announcement window & PR owner
marcel: runtime notes: we need to expose incoming traceparent, forward to backend, and ensure KV cache spans don't explode cardinality. example snippet for propagation config:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: "https://collector.redwood-internal:4318/v1/traces"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlphttp]
```
jess: for marketplace tile — what top 3 benefits should we highlight? I'm thinking: predictable latency tracing, end-to-end correlation with logs, turnkey dashboards/templates. agree?
sahil: +1. add "minimal instrumenting required" as a callout (dev experience wins). also can we include a tiny gif of the trace waterfall for the quickstart.
olivia: owners: marcel -> runtime & collector config; jess -> marketplace copy/assets & legal; sahil -> quickstart + demo. I'll take PR owner for joint announcement and cadence with partnerships comms.
marcel: small ask — does Datadog require a partner technical review before listing dashboards? if so we should loop them in now.
jess: yes they do. i'll ping our DD contact and cc partnerships legal.
integrations-bot: created JIRA RED-INT-842: "Tracing integration: Datadog + OTel checklist" assigned to olivia, marcel, jess, sahil. due 2026-04-02.
sahil: putting a placeholder in my calendar for demo prep on Thu 10am PT. invite sent.
olivia: thanks team — let's hit the checklist items this week. small follow-up: marcel, can you drop a short doc in /docs/integrations/tracing with exportable dashboard JSON by EOD tomorrow?
marcel: yup will do. :thumbsup:
